_comment: THE COURIER BAG — chapter card data.
SOURCE OF TRUTH. Two of the three supplied documents agree and one does not.
The Gio brief ('The eight categories') and the tutorial transcript describe
the SAME eight groups in the SAME order with the same contents. On camera:
'by the end of working through a all the way to h', 'this is F in letters',
'the final letter is G', 'assembly and binding is the letter H'. Every
description below is checked against both.
The COLOUR_CODED_A0.pdf carries a different legend (A=BODY SHELL,
B=BODY LINING, C=SIDE POCKETS, D=EXTERIOR ZIP POCKETS, E=LAPTOP SLEEVE,
F=UTILITY ORGANISER, G=STRAP & SHOULDER PAD, H=CLOSURE & STRAPS). That is a
different grouping of the same pieces and it contradicts the audio — the
video calls the utility organiser A, that sheet calls it F. It is treated
Each chapter carries BOTH a letter and a number so the marker can be

cards.title: THE BUILD
cards.sub: Eight categories. Sort your pieces by letter, then work straight down the list.

cards.title:
THE UTILITY
ORGANISER
cards.sub: Start here — it is the hardest
cards.line: The horseshoe-zip module and the front panel it mounts to.
cards.extra: Plus the closure-tab strip  ·  pen compartments  ·  velcro divider
cards.stitchNote: slow and deliberate — the most complex module in the pattern

cards.title:
SIDE PANELS
& POCKETS
cards.line: Merged side panel, bellows pocket, corner reinforcement, buckle strap.
cards.extra: Optional cinch: two eyelets and a cord  ·  reused later in F
cards.stitchNote: even — three panels joined and topstitched

cards.title:
BACK, FLAP,
CLOSURE & HANDLE
cards.line: Main back and flap panel, both welted pockets, Cobra closure, grab handle.
cards.extra: Welt pockets  ·  handle base patch  ·  closure base patches
cards.stitchNote: careful — welts are the least forgiving seam here

cards.title: THE BOTTOM
cards.line: Base panel, reinforcement strap, and the bottom corner reinforcements.
cards.extra: 25mm webbing, or cut the strap in fabric
cards.stitchNote: quick — three straight pieces, nothing to fight

cards.title:
THE LAPTOP
SLEEVE
cards.line: Padded sleeve for a 14in machine. Cut mirrored, outer shell and lining.
cards.extra: Built now, trapped inside the lining later
cards.stitchNote: steady — padding wants an even feed

cards.title: THE LINING
cards.line: Rebuilt without facings, so both body panels run full depth.
cards.extra: Bring the side panel back from B and cut it in lining
cards.stitchNote: open and even — long uninterrupted seams

cards.title:
STRAP &
SHOULDER PAD
cards.line: Main strap, adjuster, padded shoulder pad, utility loops, velcro wrap.
cards.extra: 38mm webbing for the straps, 25mm for the loops
cards.stitchNote: fast and long — box stitches and straight runs

cards.title:
ASSEMBLY
& BINDING
cards.line: Lining drops into the shell, and one run of binding closes the top edge.
cards.extra: Bias binding all the way round the top edge
cards.stitchNote: measured — binding a closed loop is all corners
